{{Quote|Ah, then I'll assume my men are dead. Even so, you have done us a great service. Their loss is your gain I suppose.|Rikel thanks the individual who killed the looters|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rikel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> In around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] built there. While stationed there he issued [[Imperial Edict 936]], an order to eliminate a number of looters who had begun scavenging in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]] due to the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]] infestation there. Rikel sent a number of [[Imperial soldier|soldiers]] under his command to carry out the order, but all were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Rikel had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and grey [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], while at the academy he wore a red suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Rikel was then approached by an Imperial aligned individual, who informed him they had found his edict recorded on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] among the remains of his men, and completed the task and eliminated the looters, recovering several artifacts as they did so. The sergeant thanked the individual and, after taking the artifacts from them, rewarded them for their efforts.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rikel first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, he was a part of the optional quest "Imperial Edict" which took place on the Imperial planet Korriban, starting world for the [[Sith Inquisitor]] and [[Sith Warrior]] classes. As any Imperial class can complete the quest this article makes no assumption about which character interacted with Rikel, but assumes the quest was completed as part of one hundred percent game completion.
